title: RestartPolicy v1 — restart resilience as data: how a restarted node re-syncs its CRDT state. The law is constants — sync_mode is always delta and full_reload_allowed is always false, so a policy naming a full-state reload fails validation; max_delta_elements bounds one delta, and a rejoin whose delta would exceed it is refused by name rather than silently becoming a bulk transfer (Y-066)
